# Select

## Summary
The single-select dropdown, wrapping ember-power-select with Boxel styling and behavior.

## Shape
`@options`, `@selected` and `@onChange` are the contract, and `@selected` accepts a promise so
a trigger can render while the current value is still loading. The option block is yielded, so
a consumer controls how each row renders while the trigger, dropdown chrome, keyboard traversal
and search stay consistent. The yielded `select` API exposes `choose`, `close`, `highlight` and
`select` for callers driving the dropdown themselves. `BoxelSelectOptions` is exported for the
shared option-shape type.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/select/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { BoxelSelect } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
